explanation: The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created the heavens, the earth, and all life.
The term used to describe God's act of bringing the universe and everything in it into existence.
The holy city that was the center of Israel's religion and politics, but here criticized for its sinfulness.
Evil deeds or thought patterns that break God's laws and lead to judgment upon the people.
God's righteous punishment against injustice and turning away from His ways, often described as a day of wrath.
The portion of the people who will be saved through purification after God's judgment is completed.
Humility or meekness; the attitude believers should have when they seek the Lord in secret.
The name of God (Jehovah) that emphasizes his eternal presence and omnipotence over all nations.
People other than Israel who will also be punished for their arrogance, but later restored in God's plans.
